scientific_limitations: Uniform finite-exchange four-state antiferromagnetic Potts model on bipyramids with nonadjacent apices, n>=6 and H>=0. Critical entropy at H/J=2 is zero-temperature only; no finite-temperature transition is claimed. Historical equivalent specializations remain possible.
title: Parity-defect plateaux and entropy-selected coexistence in four-state Potts bipyramids
